admissionInfo.text: Students will apply for formal admission to the Secondary Education and the Art and Design Department Art Education program in the semester prior to the beginning of their junior year. Admission criteria include: ENGL and MATH QL courses must have a grade C or higher. GPA of 3.0 or higher with no grade lower than a C in discipline core courses. Completion of all General Education requirements and 70% of content area courses. Pass LiveScan Criminal Background Check.
